# Vision For Xperiences (vfx.productions)

> Vision For Xperiences creates cinematic 3D, animation, and interactive visuals
> for products, spaces, performances, and ideas that are difficult to show.
> One studio, one pipeline: animation, VFX, design visualisation, live visuals
> and interactive installations. Based in Rijswijk, the Netherlands.

Contact: studio@vfx.productions (briefs answered within 48 hours).
Budget bands: under EUR 1,000 / EUR 1,000-5,000 / EUR 5,000-15,000 / EUR 15,000+.
Takes on work at budget levels most full-service houses decline.

## Work
- [All work](/work): projects grouped by the audience they were made for
- [Product & Technology](/industries/product-technology): medical, offshore, vehicles, vessels, technical products
- [Architecture & Spaces](/industries/architecture-spaces): buildings, interiors, retail and logistics environments
- [Music & Culture](/industries/music-culture): artists, stages, festivals, cultural projects
- [Fashion & Luxury](/industries/fashion-luxury): material, light and mood-led 3D imagery
- [Film & Commercial](/industries/film-commercial): VFX, set extension and finishing for film and series

## Case studies
- [CYBERAWARE](/work/cyberaware): An interactive cybersecurity awareness installation that turns an abstract threat into something visitors operate with their hands.
- [Giving an AI a Face](/work/ai-head): A concept render for an AI art piece — a glass head with an LED cube suspended inside it, standing on a dock you can talk to.
- [Cyberphone](/work/cyberphone): A concept phone drawn in the Tesla Cybertruck’s design language — flat planes, hard folds, exposed stainless, and a flip.
- [Sea and Shore Services](/work/sea-and-shore): Brand identity worked out in 3D for a logistics company — putting the mark on container ships and container stacks to see how it actually behaves at scale.
- [Driving, Simulated](/work/vr-driving-simulator): A brand commercial for a VR driving-simulator startup, built around the moment the real car and the simulated one turn out to be the same thing.
- [Catamaran](/work/catamaran): A commercial for a performance sailing catamaran, built to see whether a hull can be sold the way a car is.
- [Freight Calculator](/work/freight-calculator): The login screen for a freight-rate app — a container ship coming straight at you, and the hull used as the brand surface.
- [Hooiberg](/work/hooiberg): An architectural animation of a house that borrows its structure from the Dutch hooiberg — the hay barn whose roof rides on masts — and rebuilds it as a modern home.
- [DHG — Logwise](/work/dhg-logwise): Visualisation for a portfolio of Logwise distribution centres — a film for the flagship site plus site models for individual locations.
- [Fountain Fuel — Brand Movie](/work/fountain-fuel): A brand film for a Dutch hydrogen and fast-charging network, built around a station that mostly did not exist yet.
- [Off To A Better Future](/work/carbon-neutral): A brand film for five companies building a carbon-neutral logistics centre together — solar in, hydrogen out, trucks running on it.
- [Broederliefde × AFAS Live](/work/broederliefde): Show visuals for Broederliefde’s set at the FunX Music Awards — content built for the arena’s main LED wall and run live behind the group for the whole set.
- [FLAIRE × Maassilo](/work/flaire-maassilo): A show package for FLAIRE built around a rendered Rotterdam skyline, made for the big screens at the Maassilo.
- [Tessaract](/work/tessaract): An infinite mirror room — a reflective real-time environment built as a loop for screens and installations.
- [Loro Piana — Open Walk](/work/loro-piana-open-walk): A commercial rebuilding the Loro Piana Open Walk in black suede, down to the crest stamped into the footbed — made to prove an existing product can be recreated in full CG.
- [C.P. Company — Integrated Mask](/work/cp-company-mask): A concept study from the COVID period: a face mask built into the garment itself, clipped on and off, in the language of C.P. Company.
- [Ready Set Studios](/work/ready-set-studios): A dimensioned 3D model of a film studio, built from the architectural drawings so clients could judge the space before booking it.
- [Street Takeover](/work/street-takeover): A real Heineken truck on a real street, with the bottle printed on its side pulled out of the livery and made physical — VFX, CG and Houdini liquid on an otherwise ordinary shot.

## Studio
Founded by Kees Moolenaar, 3D generalist and creative technologist (6+ years).
BA Image & Media Technology, HKU Utrecht. Film and TV work via VFX studio Planet X:
El Eternauta (Netflix series, 3D artist, 2025), De Vuurwerkramp (series, 3D artist, 2025),
De Tatta's 3 (feature, virtual production artist, 2025). IMDb: nm17152376.

## News
- [Does one studio really handle previz through delivery](/news/does-one-studio-really-handle-previz-through-delivery/): Some do, but the trend is toward specialists who know when to hand off. Here's how to tell the difference.
- [Houdini 22 brings MCP agents into character rigging workflows](/news/houdini-22-brings-mcp-agents-into-character-rigging-workflows/): SideFX wired AI code generation into KineFX, letting riggers scaffold procedural setups faster without surrendering control.
- [DJI Avata 360 shifts FPV from linear chase work to 360 capture](/news/dji-avata-360-shifts-fpv-from-linear-chase-work-to-360-capture/): Eight-kilohertz 360-degree video and single-lens fallback mode open new options for spatial storytelling and post-production freedom.
- [ISO 22028-5 sets a common language for HDR still image colour](/news/iso-22028-5-sets-a-common-language-for-hdr-still-image-colour/): A new international standard published in May defines how studios encode, store, and deliver HDR photographs and graphics with consistent colour across devices.
- [Vicon acquires face capture firm, closing the pipeline gap](/news/vicon-acquires-face-capture-firm-closing-the-pipeline-gap/): Facial and body performance capture have always come from different vendors. That just changed.
- [Open source flips the commercial 3D software economics](/news/open-source-flips-the-commercial-3d-software-economics/): Vendor lock-in is now the top reason organizations choose free tools over licensed subscriptions, reshaping how studios pitch to clients and how they budget.
- [How to pick a studio for a 3D product animation](/news/how-to-pick-a-studio-for-a-3d-product-animation/): Current rates span from 5k to 25k per finished minute. We mapped who does what work and at what price point.
- [Building real-time interactive experiences for museums and exhibitions](/news/building-real-time-interactive-experiences-for-museums-and-exhibitions/): A practical guide to finding the right studio for hands-on installations that respond to visitors in real time.
- [August broke open the Gaussian splatting toolkit](/news/august-broke-open-the-gaussian-splatting-toolkit/): Major VFX and 3D software shipped native splat support in five days, signalling production is no longer an experiment.
